abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] AI-enabled digital medicine platforms in Europe are developed within overlapping rules for personal data, medical devices, AI, clinical research, health data access, and health technology assessment. This viewpoint represents the authors' experience and interpretation from the preimplementation phase of INTERCEPT, an Innovative Health Initiative consortium that plans to validate biomarkers and develop a blood-based risk score for early Crohn disease interception. It does not report original empirical research, a systematic regulatory review, a deployed platform, or a validated AI model. Our aim is to explain how compliance-by-design can be translated into an auditable governance architecture and to identify what still requires scientific evaluation. We advance 3 messages. First, governance must begin with intended purpose and boundary mapping: a digital platform may contain research, operational, and medical device software functions, and conformity of one module cannot be inferred for the platform as a whole. Second, overlapping obligations can be operationalized through 5 linked controls: modular responsibility and change control, federated data governance, traceable AI life cycle management, consent and participant rights orchestration, and a common cross-border governance core with local adaptations. Third, compliance is not a surrogate for model validity, clinical benefit, trust, scalability, or market access. Before clinical deployment, planned AI components require prespecified labels and cohorts, leakage prevention, missing data and imbalance strategies, calibration, subgroup assessment, external validation, human factors evaluation, and postdeployment algorithmovigilance. A hypothetical biomarker risk score update illustrates how the 5 controls interact. INTERCEPT is informative because it combines cross-border biomarker research, planned predictive analytics, and heterogeneous institutional settings while key design decisions remain modifiable. Its contribution is nevertheless conceptual: the proposed framework is a testable governance hypothesis, not evidence of implementation success. Prospective studies should compare it with alternative governance models and assess safety, workload, participant experience, evidence generation, and regulatory performance.
zh_abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] 欧洲基于人工智能（AI）的数字医学平台是在个人数据、医疗器械、AI、临床研究、健康数据获取以及卫生技术评估等相互重叠的规则下开发的。本观点文章代表作者在 INTERCEPT 实施前阶段的经验与解读。INTERCEPT 是创新健康倡议（Innovative Health Initiative）下的一个联盟，计划验证生物标志物并开发基于血液的风险评分，用于克罗恩病的早期拦截。本文不报告原始实证研究、系统性法规综述、已部署的平台或经验证的 AI 模型。我们的目的是阐明如何将“合规设计”（compliance-by-design）转化为可审计的治理架构，并指出哪些方面仍需科学评估。我们提出三点主要观点。第一，治理必须从预期用途和边界映射开始：一个数字平台可能同时包含研究、运营和医疗器械软件功能，不能由某一模块的符合性推断整个平台的符合性。第二，相互重叠的义务可通过 5 项相互关联的控制措施来落实：模块化责任与变更控制、联邦式数据治理、可追溯的 AI 生命周期管理、知情同意与参与者权利的统筹，以及带有本地适配的通用跨境治理核心。第三，合规并不能替代模型有效性、临床获益、信任、可扩展性或市场准入。在临床部署之前，计划使用的 AI 组件需要预先设定的标签和队列、防止数据泄漏、缺失数据与类别不平衡的处理策略、校准、亚组评估、外部验证、人因工程评估以及部署后的算法警戒。我们以一个假设的生物标志物风险评分更新为例，说明这 5 项控制措施如何相互作用。INTERCEPT 具有参考价值，因为它结合了跨境生物标志物研究、计划中的预测分析和异质性的机构环境，同时关键设计决策仍可修改。然而其贡献是概念性的：所提出的框架是一个可检验的治理假设，而非实施成功的证据。前瞻性研究应将其与其他治理模式进行比较，并评估安全性、工作负担、参与者体验、证据产出和监管表现。

title: A four-step validation protocol for radiomic survival analysis in small cohorts: a body composition case study
zh_title: 小队列影像组学生存分析的四步验证方案：体成分案例
summary: 提出针对小样本影像组学生存分析的四步验证流程，并在78例胃肠胰神经内分泌肿瘤患者中用L3体成分特征演示。
key_points: 含FDR校正特征选择、双路径比较、重复嵌套交叉验证
加入高斯噪声特征作为阴性对照
78例GEP-NET，535个影像组学特征，评估五种生存模型
reason: 单中心小样本方法学研究，无外部验证
abstract: Gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NET) lack prognostic biomarkers, and computed tomography (CT)-based body composition radiomics at the third lumbar vertebra (L3) is a promising candidate. Small cohorts make high-dimensional radiomic models prone to overfitting and single-split evaluations variable and optimistic. This methodological study proposes a four-step validation protocol for radiomic survival analysis in small cohorts: (1) false discovery rate (FDR)-corrected feature selection, (2) a dual-path comparison of prior feature selection versus embedded regularization, (3) repeated nested cross-validation (CV) and (4) a negative control with Gaussian noise features. In 78 GEP-NET patients, 535 radiomic features from five L3 compartments were used to evaluate five survival models with Harrell's concordance index (C-index), time-dependent area under the curve (AUC) and integrated Brier score (IBS). Step 1 selected at least one feature in 18% of outer folds under noise (nominal level 20%) versus 84% with radiomic features. The dual-path comparison showed no consistent difference between strategies. Repeated nested CV reduced variability across seeds (41% median reduction in C-index standard deviation), but not enough to distinguish models. The nested CV C-index exceeded chance by 0.07-0.15 with radiomic features but not clearly under noise (0.40-0.42 with prior feature selection, 0.47-0.55 with embedded regularization). Frequently selected features tentatively linked greater subcutaneous fat, skeletal muscle compactness and texture to better prognosis. These findings suggest a modest prognostic signal in L3 radiomics, with considerable uncertainty that the protocol quantifies. The protocol may transfer to other small-cohort radiomic survival studies. Code: https://github.com/marielatalaveram/radiomics-survival-validation-protocol.
zh_abstract: 胃肠胰神经内分泌肿瘤（GEP-NET）缺乏预后生物标志物，而基于计算机断层扫描（CT）、在第三腰椎（L3）水平的体成分影像组学是一个有前景的候选。小样本队列使高维影像组学模型容易过拟合，并使单次划分评估结果波动且偏乐观。这项方法学研究提出了一种适用于小样本队列影像组学生存分析的四步验证方案：（1）经错误发现率（FDR）校正的特征选择；（2）先验特征选择与嵌入式正则化的双路径比较；（3）重复嵌套交叉验证（CV）；（4）以高斯噪声特征作为阴性对照。在 78 例 GEP-NET 患者中，使用来自 L3 五个组织区室的 535 个影像组学特征，以 Harrell 一致性指数（C-index）、时间依赖性曲线下面积（AUC）和积分 Brier 评分（IBS）评估五种生存模型。第 1 步在噪声条件下于 18% 的外层折中至少选出一个特征（名义水平 20%），而使用影像组学特征时为 84%。双路径比较显示两种策略之间无一致差异。重复嵌套 CV 降低了不同随机种子间的变异（C-index 标准差中位数降低 41%），但不足以区分各模型。使用影像组学特征时，嵌套 CV 的 C-index 比随机水平高 0.07–0.15，而在噪声条件下则不明显（先验特征选择为 0.40–0.42，嵌入式正则化为 0.47–0.55）。被频繁选中的特征初步提示：皮下脂肪较多、骨骼肌致密度较高和纹理特征与较好预后相关。这些结果提示 L3 影像组学存在适度的预后信号，但存在相当大的不确定性，该方案对此进行了量化。该方案可能适用于其他小样本队列的影像组学生存研究。代码：https://github.com/marielatalaveram/radiomics-survival-validation-protocol。

title: Do AI Agents need Preventive Care? An Epidemiologic Cohort Design for Agentic AI
zh_title: AI智能体需要预防保健吗？面向智能体的流行病学队列设计
summary: 提出把智能体视为队列成员、底层模型视为遗传背景、累计工作量视为时间尺度的流行病学队列框架，纵向研究其行为与不良事件。
key_points: 借鉴人群研究原则评估智能体
可研究不良事件的行为决定因素
在因果假设下估计可预防负担
reason: 概念性框架预印本，未见实证验证
abstract: As AI agents increasingly perform tasks autonomously across sectors, including healthcare and biomedical research, understanding how their behaviors develop and influence outcomes over time becomes increasingly important. Existing evaluations largely focus on model capabilities and performance on predefined tasks. Here, we propose an epidemiologic cohort design for studying agentic AI, drawing on principles established in human population studies. The framework treats individual agents as members of a cohort, their underlying model as genetic makeup, accumulated work as their time scale, and naturally occurring behaviors as exposures that may influence subsequent outcomes. By following agents longitudinally, this approach enables investigation of behavioral determinants of adverse events, estimation of their potential preventable burden under causal assumptions, and characterization of behavioral changes over an agent's work life. We illustrate the design through two prospective observational cohorts examining curiosity and probing as a safety question, and data checking and analytical accuracy as a reliability question. Together, the framework and illustrative studies provide a generalizable blueprint for designing epidemiologic cohorts of AI agents.

title: Domain adaptation of a video Foundation model for Heart Failure Diagnosis from Echocardiography
zh_title: 视频基础模型迁移至超声心动图诊断射血分数降低型心衰
summary: 微调预训练视频模型TimeSformer，基于心尖四腔心视频诊断HFrEF，在公开RVENet数据集上优于仅分类器微调和3D CNN基线。
key_points: 采用相位感知的收缩/舒张片段生成策略
使用分层学习率衰减与多片段推理
全量微调优于分类器微调和3D CNN
reason: 预印本，单一公开数据集，增量改进
abstract: The rapid advancement of foundation models has transformed computer vision, yet their adaptation to medical imaging, particularly purpose built foundation models for spatio temporal echocardiography videos, remains limited. In this work, we explore the feasibility of fine tuning a pretrained foundation model for video (TimeSformer) for automated diagnosis of reduced ejection fraction heart failure (HFrEF) from apical four chamber videos. The model is finetuned on the publicly available RVENet A4C dataset with a phase aware clip generation strategy that captures complementary systolic and diastolic dynamics. We employ divided space time attention, layer wise learning rate decay, and multi clip inference to enhance robustness under limited data. Experimental results show that full fine tuning of the proposed model outperforms classifier only tuning and a 3D CNN baseline. These findings highlight the potential of leveraging foundation video models for echocardiography based heart failure diagnosis and motivates further domain adaptation studies in medical imaging.
zh_abstract: 基础模型的快速发展已经改变了计算机视觉领域，但其在医学影像中的应用，尤其是专为时空超声心动图视频构建的基础模型，仍然有限。在这项工作中，我们探讨了对预训练视频基础模型（TimeSformer）进行微调，以基于心尖四腔心视频自动诊断射血分数降低型心力衰竭（HFrEF）的可行性。该模型在公开可用的 RVENet A4C 数据集上进行微调，并采用能够捕捉互补的收缩期和舒张期动态的相位感知片段生成策略。我们采用分离式时空注意力（divided space time attention）、逐层学习率衰减以及多片段推理，以在数据有限的情况下提高稳健性。实验结果表明，所提出模型的全量微调优于仅微调分类器的方式以及 3D CNN 基线。这些发现凸显了利用视频基础模型进行基于超声心动图的心力衰竭诊断的潜力，并推动了医学影像领域进一步的领域适应研究。

title: Towards Scalable Network-Based Interventions for HIV Treatment and Prevention via R2C-Agent
zh_title: R2C-Agent：面向HIV防治的可扩展网络干预
summary: 针对同伴推荐网络与真实接触网络的偏差，提出R2C-Agent用于HIV防治资源的网络化定向干预。
key_points: 同伴推荐网络可规模化采集但偏离接触网络
目标为优化HIV干预资源定向
摘要信息有限，细节未给出
reason: 公共卫生算法预印本，摘要缺少结果，证据有限
abstract: Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) remains a pressing public health challenge worldwide. Targeting limited HIV prevention and treatment resources effectively with network-based algorithms is a long-standing problem with a rich history at AAMAS and other computational venues. However, optimizing targeted biomedical interventions for minimizing spread of HIV often requires observability of the contact network of HIV transmission risk behavior among individuals, which is prohibitively expensive to collect at scale. Peer referral networks, i.e., networks collected through a recursive peer referral process, are an alternative network class often used to study HIV in hidden populations that can be collected digitally at scale, but they deviate from the underlying contact network: referrals can follow non-risk social ties and participants accept only one referral, hiding contacts among already-recruited individuals. In this work, we first formalize the novel problem of planning network-based interventions to minimize HIV spread in the hidden contact network while observing only the peer referral network. Second, we implement R2C-Agent, a decision making agent for interventions that is designed around our new conditional graph diffusion model called Referral-to-Contact Diffusion (R2C-Diff). R2C-Diff positions the peer referral process as incremental corruption of the underlying contact network and learns to reverse it. R2C-Agent plans its interventions over contact networks sampled from R2C-Diff, so its decisions account for uncertainty about the hidden contact network. Finally, we conduct simulated experiments using real-world HIV network data that demonstrate that R2C-Agent empirically plans more effective interventions than baselines from interdisciplinary literature and highlight key tradeoffs and assumptions driving performance.
zh_abstract: 人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）仍是全球紧迫的公共卫生挑战。利用基于网络的算法有效地分配有限的HIV预防和治疗资源，是一个由来已久的问题，在AAMAS及其他计算领域会议中有着丰富的研究历史。然而，要优化有针对性的生物医学干预以最大限度减少HIV传播，通常需要能够观察个体之间HIV传播风险行为的接触网络，而大规模收集这种网络的成本高得令人望而却步。同伴推荐网络，即通过递归同伴推荐过程收集的网络，是一类常用于研究隐匿人群中HIV的替代网络，可以通过数字方式大规模收集，但它与底层接触网络存在偏差：推荐可能沿着非风险性社会关系进行，且参与者只接受一次推荐，从而隐藏了已入组个体之间的接触。在这项工作中，我们首先形式化了一个新问题：在仅能观察到同伴推荐网络的情况下，规划基于网络的干预措施，以最大限度减少HIV在隐藏接触网络中的传播。其次，我们实现了R2C-Agent，这是一个围绕我们提出的新型条件图扩散模型“推荐到接触扩散”（Referral-to-Contact Diffusion，R2C-Diff）设计的干预决策智能体。R2C-Diff将同伴推荐过程视为对底层接触网络的逐步破坏，并学习将其逆转。R2C-Agent在从R2C-Diff采样得到的接触网络上规划其干预措施，因此其决策考虑了隐藏接触网络的不确定性。最后，我们使用真实世界的HIV网络数据进行了模拟实验，结果表明R2C-Agent在经验上比跨学科文献中的基线方法规划出更有效的干预措施，并突出了驱动性能的关键权衡和假设。

title: Decisions by Discrimination: Differential Evidence for Medical Reasoning
zh_title: 以判别取胜：用于医学推理的差异证据框架
summary: 提出检索增强的差异证据框架，提取选项特异性证据并组织成提示，用于医学选择题作答。
key_points: 针对选项间证据重叠的医学MCQ
提取区分易混选项的紧凑差异证据
属检索增强提示方法
reason: 新方法但摘要无结果数据，仅MCQ评测
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly studied for clinical decision support, and medical question answering provides a testbed for evaluating this capability. In particular, medical multiple-choice questions (MCQs) reflect a core challenge in clinical decision-making: plausible options often share overlapping evidence, while only a few decisive factors distinguish the correct option from incorrect ones. However, existing retrieval-based and reasoning-oriented methods mainly focus on supplying broadly relevant knowledge or eliciting reasoning paths, rather than identifying the compact differential evidence that separates confusing alternatives. In this work, we present a retrieval-grounded differential evidence framework for medical MCQs. Our method extracts option-specific pieces of differential evidence and organizes them into concise evidence prompts for answer selection. This design better aligns external knowledge with differential reasoning while reducing irrelevant context. Experiments show consistent accuracy gains across multiple datasets and target LLMs. Ablation studies further show that our framework outperforms both directly using retrieved evidence chunks and closed-source LLM-generated general hints, and that its improvements are not solely explained by answer-proximal guidance, but are consistent with differential evidence serving as a compact aid for reasoning over competing alternatives. Our findings also offer insights for medical reasoning and other decision-making settings with multiple possible choices.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在临床决策支持方面的研究日益增多，而医学问答为评估这一能力提供了试验平台。特别是，医学多项选择题（MCQ）反映了临床决策中的一个核心难题：看似合理的选项往往共享重叠的证据，而只有少数决定性因素能将正确选项与错误选项区分开来。然而，现有的基于检索和面向推理的方法主要侧重于提供广泛相关的知识或引出推理路径，而不是识别能够区分易混淆备选项的精简的差异性证据。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种面向医学MCQ的基于检索的差异证据框架。我们的方法提取各选项特有的差异证据片段，并将其组织成简明的证据提示以用于答案选择。这一设计使外部知识与差异推理更好地对齐，同时减少了无关上下文。实验表明，在多个数据集和目标LLM上准确率均获得一致提升。消融研究进一步表明，我们的框架优于直接使用检索到的证据片段以及由闭源LLM生成的通用提示，且其改进并非仅由接近答案的引导所解释，而是与差异证据作为对竞争备选项进行推理的精简辅助手段相一致。我们的研究结果也为医学推理以及其他存在多个可能选项的决策情境提供了启示。

title: Artificial intelligence in emergency trauma perioperative management: applications, performance benchmarks, and translation barriers.
zh_title: AI在急诊创伤围手术期管理：应用、性能基准与转化障碍
summary: 综述AI在院前分诊、影像损伤检测、大量输血预测和术后并发症预警中的应用，指出外部验证性能下降与缺乏前瞻性证据等障碍。
key_points: 覆盖分诊、影像、输血预测、并发症预警
外部验证中性能下降
缺乏前瞻性干预证据，基准性能被夸大
reason: 综述类，观点明确但无新数据
abstract: [Frontiers in surgery] This review examines the current status of artificial intelligence (AI) applications in the perioperative management of emergency trauma. Published studies suggest performance advantages of AI over traditional methods in prehospital triage, radiographic injury detection, massive transfusion prediction, and early warning of postoperative complications, although findings vary across study designs and validation settings. However, actual adoption in trauma care remains limited due to data heterogeneity, performance degradation in external validation, workflow integration challenges, lack of interpretability, and a scarcity of prospective interventional evidence. This review further argues that methodologically inflated benchmark performance constitutes an underrecognized barrier to adoption in its own right, and that bridging the implementation gap will likely require a shift from area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC)-centered reporting toward reporting sensitivity at prespecified clinical thresholds and evaluating patient outcomes in prospective interventional trials.

title: Operation-aware Multimodal Clinical Decision Support System for ICU Discharge Risk Assessment
zh_title: 面向ICU出科风险评估的运营感知多模态决策支持系统
summary: 提出结合运营背景（科室负荷、入院流量）与多模态数据的ICU 30天再入院风险评估系统，使用多智能体抽取和自进化RAG处理病程记录。
key_points: 纳入科室工作负荷等运营指标
多智能体抽取结合自进化RAG
针对约10.5%再入院的类别不平衡
reason: 预印本，摘要未见外部验证，偏增量档
abstract: Unplanned 30-day intensive care unit (ICU) readmission is a critical benchmark for evaluating healthcare quality. Most predictive models assume readmission risk depends solely on a patient's individual pathophysiological state, ignoring hospital operational context and resource capacity. In practice, discharge decisions are dynamic trade-offs between patient stability and bed turnover pressures. To address this gap, we develop an Operation-aware Multimodal Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) for ICU discharge risk assessment. The system combines multi-agent collaborative extraction with self-evolving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to eliminate template noise from progress notes, while constructing departmental workload indicators alongside admission flow features, continuous vital signs, and sparse medical codes (ICD/DRG). Addressing severe class imbalance (about 10.5% readmissions) and alarm fatigue, we implement data normalization, class reweighting, and decision-threshold calibration. In 20 independent runs across 20,000 ICU stays from MIMIC-III, empirical findings demonstrate that: vital signs alone have limited predictive capacity under real-world class imbalance (PR-AUC of 0.1387 +/- 0.0086); directly concatenating raw text embeddings degrades decision tree performance (XGBoost and LightGBM PR-AUC drop to 0.3893 and 0.4030); whereas an end-to-end multimodal fine-tuning architecture (Transformer E2E FineTune) utilizing layer-wise parameter freezing and differential learning rates reverses text negative transfer, achieving the highest AUROC of 0.8288 +/- 0.0110, PR-AUC of 0.4373 +/- 0.0310, and F1-Score of 0.4757 +/- 0.0196. Operational indicators supply independent risk signals, laying an engineering foundation for high-utility clinical decision support tools.
zh_abstract: 计划外的 30 天重症监护病房（ICU）再入院是评估医疗质量的重要基准。大多数预测模型假定再入院风险仅取决于患者个体的病理生理状态，忽视了医院运营环境和资源容量。实际上，出院决策是在患者稳定性与床位周转压力之间动态权衡的结果。为弥补这一空白，我们开发了一种用于 ICU 出院风险评估的运营感知多模态临床决策支持系统（CDSS）。该系统将多智能体协作提取与自进化检索增强生成（RAG）相结合，以消除病程记录中的模板噪声，同时构建科室工作负荷指标，并结合入院流量特征、连续生命体征和稀疏医学编码（ICD/DRG）。针对严重的类别不平衡（再入院约占 10.5%）和警报疲劳问题，我们实施了数据归一化、类别重加权和决策阈值校准。在对来自 MIMIC-III 的 20,000 次 ICU 住院进行的 20 次独立运行中，实证结果表明：在真实世界类别不平衡条件下，仅用生命体征的预测能力有限（PR-AUC 为 0.1387 ± 0.0086）；直接拼接原始文本嵌入会降低决策树模型的性能（XGBoost 和 LightGBM 的 PR-AUC 分别降至 0.3893 和 0.4030）；而采用逐层参数冻结和差异化学习率的端到端多模态微调架构（Transformer E2E FineTune）扭转了文本的负迁移，取得最高的 AUROC 0.8288 ± 0.0110、PR-AUC 0.4373 ± 0.0310 和 F1 分数 0.4757 ± 0.0196。运营指标提供了独立的风险信号，为高实用性临床决策支持工具奠定了工程基础。

title: Odds-Structured Distributional Regression for Interpretable Time-to-Event Prediction
zh_title: 面向可解释事件时间预测的比值结构分布回归
summary: 提出ODDS-DR，使分布回归的输出参数在对数几率上可加，以提升事件时间预测的可解释性，面向临床风险建模。
key_points: 输出参数设计为对数几率可加
对应临床风险建模常用度量
处理部分可观测与偶然不确定性
reason: 预印本方法创新，摘要证据有限，增量档
abstract: Time-to-event prediction is fundamentally challenged by partial observability and aleatoric uncertainty. In clinical medicine, for instance, the timing of disease progression or acute readmission is contingent on highly dynamic and largely latent health trajectories. Rather than forcing a deterministic point forecast, distributional regression offers a principled means to address this complexity by predicting a probability distribution over time. However, explaining these distributional predictions presents a key obstacle: raw distribution parameters output by the model are abstract mathematical quantities that do not align well with domain concepts. To gain interpretability, we propose a novel paradigm where output parameters are designed to be additive in log-odds---a widely established measure in clinical risk modeling. Our approach, called ODDS-DR, moves beyond technical convenience to deliver clear domain alignment as well as the layer-wise computational structure required for robust, time-dependent feature attribution. Validated across two real-world clinical cohorts, our framework matches state-of-the-art predictive performance while resolving distributional outputs into interpretable risk markers across flexible prognostic horizons.
zh_abstract: 时间-事件预测从根本上受到部分可观测性和偶然不确定性的挑战。例如在临床医学中，疾病进展或急性再入院的时间取决于高度动态且在很大程度上潜在的健康轨迹。分布回归不是强行给出确定性的点预测，而是通过预测随时间变化的概率分布，为应对这种复杂性提供了有原则的手段。然而，解释这些分布预测存在关键障碍：模型输出的原始分布参数是抽象的数学量，与领域概念不能很好地对应。为获得可解释性，我们提出一种新范式，将输出参数设计为在对数优势（log-odds）上具有可加性——这是临床风险建模中广泛确立的度量。我们的方法称为 ODDS-DR，超越了技术上的便利，既实现了清晰的领域对应，又提供了稳健的、随时间变化的特征归因所需的逐层计算结构。在两个真实世界临床队列中验证表明，我们的框架达到了最先进的预测性能，同时能将分布输出解析为跨灵活预后时间范围的可解释风险标志物。

title: Leveraging High-Activity Post-Therapeutic I-131 Scans for Deep Learning Reconstruction of Extremely Sparse Planar Images in Differentiated Thyroid Cancer
zh_title: 利用高活度治疗后I-131扫描重建极稀疏平面图像
summary: 单中心前瞻研究（111例），以治疗后I-131扫描为训练参考，基于Restormer增强分化型甲状腺癌的稀疏诊断平面图像。
key_points: 训练/随访/测试三组共111例患者
比较五种Restormer模型与迁移学习
用高质量治疗后扫描作训练参考
reason: 单中心小样本预印本，有前瞻设计但无外部验证
abstract: Background: Diagnostic I-131 whole-body planar imaging in differentiated thyroid cancer (DTC) is count-limited by low administered activity, and quality worsens under rapid acquisition. Models trained on such data struggle because their targets lack photon statistics. Purpose: To test whether high-quality post-therapeutic (PT) I-131 scans can serve as superior training references for enhancing sparse diagnostic planar images, using transfer learning and input-image addition. Methods: In this single-center prospective study, 111 patients were enrolled in PT training (n = 19), diagnostic follow-up (FU) training (n = 58), and FU paired test (n = 34) cohorts. Five Restormer-based models were trained: FU_DLx2 on FU labels; PT_DLx2 transfer-learned on PT data; PT_DLx1+ and PT_DLx2+ with input-image addition; PT_DLx6 as a PT-only reference. Test-time processing used two-step denormalization and Poisson re-scaling to preserve noise statistics. Quality was assessed by PSNR, SSIM, and a blinded dual-reader evaluation of all 34 test-cohort patients. Results: PT_DLx2 achieved the highest PSNR (34.4 +/- 3.6 dB) and SSIM (0.81 +/- 0.07). PT_DLx1+ and PT_DLx2+ were comparable (33.8 and 33.3 dB; SSIM 0.80). FU_DLx2 ranked below the unprocessed fast scan (30.3 vs. 32.0 dB; 0.76 vs. 0.79). Subjectively, PT_DLx2+ scored highest in image quality (4.54 +/- 0.60) and diagnostic confidence (4.54 +/- 0.60), surpassing the reference standard (4.19 +/- 0.83 and 4.31 +/- 0.81; P = 0.005 and P = 0.008). FU_DLx2 and PT_DLx6 scored lowest. Conclusion: Count-rich PT scans provide effective training priors for reconstructing extremely sparse images. Input-image addition and cross-domain transfer learning from PT data outperformed direct training on count-limited diagnostic data, supporting 2x scan acceleration with quality matching or exceeding the unaccelerated standard scan for selected PT-derived configurations.
zh_abstract: 【背景】分化型甲状腺癌（DTC）的诊断性I-131全身平面显像受限于低给药活度导致的计数不足，且在快速采集下质量进一步下降。基于此类数据训练的模型表现不佳，因为其目标缺乏光子统计量。【目的】检验高质量的治疗后（PT）I-131扫描能否通过迁移学习和输入图像叠加，作为增强稀疏诊断性平面图像的更优训练参考。【方法】在这项单中心前瞻性研究中，111例患者被纳入PT训练队列（n = 19）、诊断性随访（FU）训练队列（n = 58）和FU配对测试队列（n = 34）。训练了五个基于Restormer的模型：以FU标签训练的FU_DLx2；在PT数据上迁移学习的PT_DLx2；采用输入图像叠加的PT_DLx1+和PT_DLx2+；以及作为仅PT参考的PT_DLx6。测试时处理采用两步反归一化和泊松重新缩放以保留噪声统计特性。质量通过PSNR、SSIM以及对全部34例测试队列患者的盲法双读者评价进行评估。【结果】PT_DLx2取得最高的PSNR（34.4 ± 3.6 dB）和SSIM（0.81 ± 0.07）。PT_DLx1+和PT_DLx2+相当（分别为33.8和33.3 dB；SSIM均为0.80）。FU_DLx2低于未处理的快速扫描（30.3对32.0 dB；0.76对0.79）。主观评价方面，PT_DLx2+在图像质量（4.54 ± 0.60）和诊断信心（4.54 ± 0.60）上得分最高，超过参考标准（分别为4.19 ± 0.83和4.31 ± 0.81；P = 0.005和P = 0.008）。FU_DLx2和PT_DLx6得分最低。【结论】计数丰富的PT扫描为重建极度稀疏的图像提供了有效的训练先验。输入图像叠加和来自PT数据的跨域迁移学习优于直接在计数受限的诊断数据上训练，支持对于选定的PT衍生配置实现2倍扫描加速，且质量达到或超过未加速的标准扫描。

title: Can the Remaining Answers Change the Prediction? Worst-Case Stability Checks for Personalized Rating Models
zh_title: 剩余答案能否改变预测？个性化评分模型的最坏情况稳定性检查
summary: 针对缺失评分可能推翻个性化模型预测的问题，提出对加性响应得分模型的精确最坏情形界，并在精神科访谈与咨询示范两个回顾性队列中评估。
key_points: 精确界可检查所有缺失赋值而不改变预测器
临床医生审计中Fisher适应较频率基线降低对数损失0.1071
认证覆盖率分别为5.4%与10.5%
reason: 回顾性、小样本，覆盖率较低，属增量档
abstract: Missing ratings can overturn a personalized model's current prediction. For completed models with additive response scores, exact worst case bounds check all missing assignments without changing the current predictor. We evaluate this audit retrospectively in two self-triage cohorts, 108 clinicians rating three simulated psychiatric interviews, and 126 counseling demonstrations annotated by ten experts. Under shared random half histories, Fisher adaptation based on observed ratings reduces log loss relative to response frequency by 0.1071 nats in the clinician audit (95% CI [0.0867,0.1261]) and 0.0223 in counseling (95% CI[0.0121,0.0321]). The counseling test excludes target experts and source videos from training. Certification covers 5.4% and 10.5% of targets; fixed width acquisition raises coverage to 13.7% and 28.6% at the same budgets. With weights and responses held fixed, the observed-rating update also has lower loss than an affine partial update while certifying exactly the same evaluated targets. The certificate establishes agreement with the completed model, not correctness or stability at intermediate updates. These rating tasks test the method; clinical usefulness remains untested.
zh_abstract: 缺失的评分可能推翻个性化模型当前的预测。对于具有加性响应得分的已完成模型，精确的最坏情况界可在不改变当前预测器的前提下检查所有缺失赋值。我们在两个自我分诊队列、108 名临床医生对三段模拟精神科访谈的评分，以及由十位专家标注的 126 个咨询示范中，对这一审计进行了回顾性评估。在共享的随机半数历史下，基于已观察评分的 Fisher 自适应相对于响应频率，在临床医生审计中使对数损失降低 0.1071 nats（95% CI [0.0867, 0.1261]），在咨询中降低 0.0223（95% CI [0.0121, 0.0321]）。咨询测试在训练中排除了目标专家和源视频。认证覆盖了 5.4% 和 10.5% 的目标；在相同预算下，固定宽度的获取将覆盖率分别提高到 13.7% 和 28.6%。在权重和响应保持不变的情况下，基于已观察评分的更新也比仿射部分更新具有更低的损失，同时认证的被评估目标完全相同。该证书确立的是与已完成模型的一致性，而非中间更新的正确性或稳定性。这些评分任务用于检验该方法；其临床实用性仍未经检验。

title: Severity-Controlled Prediction Sets for Medication Recommendation
zh_title: 用药推荐的严重度可控预测集
summary: 提出 Conformal Severity Control，利用 ATC 层级量化错配严重度，在不重训预测器的情况下校准用药推荐预测集，在 MIMIC-IV 上实验。
key_points: 基于 ATC 层级衡量漏药的错配严重度
事后校准，无需重训预测器
MIMIC-IV 上可跟踪用户设定的严重度容忍度
reason: 单一公开数据集的预印本方法，无外部验证
abstract: Medication recommendation is a multi-label prediction task. However, existing prediction-set evaluation and calibration methods rely mainly on exact-overlap metrics and therefore treat all missed medications as equally severe, overlooking how closely the prediction set matches them within the medication hierarchy. To address this, we introduce Conformal Severity Control (CSC), a post-hoc framework for calibrating medication prediction sets under hierarchy-aware mismatch severity. CSC uses the Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) hierarchy to quantify mismatch severity and controls patient-level severity without retraining the predictor, supporting both average severity and upper-quantile severity for the highest-severity mismatches. Experiments on MIMIC-IV show that CSC tracks user-specified severity tolerances and shifts prediction sets away from distant mismatches toward exact or close matches.
zh_abstract: 药物推荐是一项多标签预测任务。然而，现有的预测集评估和校准方法主要依赖精确重叠指标，因此将所有漏掉的药物视为同等严重，忽视了预测集在药物层级结构中与这些药物的接近程度。为此，我们提出了保形严重度控制（Conformal Severity Control，CSC），这是一个在层级感知的不匹配严重度下对药物预测集进行校准的事后框架。CSC 利用解剖学治疗学化学（ATC）分类层级来量化不匹配严重度，并在不重新训练预测器的情况下控制患者层面的严重度，既支持平均严重度，也支持针对最高严重度不匹配的上分位数严重度。在 MIMIC-IV 上的实验表明，CSC 能够跟踪用户指定的严重度容忍度，并使预测集从相距较远的不匹配转向精确匹配或相近匹配。

title: Room-Aware Transformer for Activities of Daily Living Recognition in Adults with Mild Neurocognitive Disorder Using Ambient Sensors: Development and Evaluation Study
zh_title: 面向轻度神经认知障碍者环境传感器日常活动识别的房间感知Transformer
summary: 在5个轻度NCD成人家庭数据上评估房间感知Transformer，与全局Transformer和LSTM比较ADL识别。
key_points: 分析5户家庭、92,765条分钟级观测
融合运动、温度、光照、湿度与门磁数据
对比全局Transformer与堆叠LSTM
reason: 仅5户小样本，预印本，无外部验证
abstract: ABSTRACT Background: Unobtrusive recognition of activities of daily living (ADLs) from ambient sensors may support longitudinal assessment of everyday functioning in adults with mild neurocognitive disorder (mild NCD). However, real-world activity recognition is complicated by heterogeneous home layouts, sensor configurations, routines, and class distributions. Objective: This study evaluated whether a room-aware Transformer that preserves location-specific sensor structure improves participant-level ADL recognition relative to a global Transformer and a stacked unidirectional long short-term memory (LSTM) network. Methods: Following pilot feasibility testing with two adult volunteers, we analyzed five homes of adults with mild NCD, comprising 92,765 minute-level observations across 67 annotated home-days. Motion, temperature, illuminance, humidity, and door-contact data were aligned to participant activity logs. The original labels were harmonized into eight categories. Models were developed separately for each home using 10-, 30-, and 60-minute windows. Complete calendar days were assigned to mutually exclusive training, validation, and chronological test sets, and no sequence crossed a day or partition boundary. The same partitions and evaluation procedures were used for all three architectures. Performance was assessed on held-out test days using accuracy, per-class F1 score, and micro- and macro-averaged one-versus-rest area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). Results: The room-aware Transformer achieved the highest or tied accuracy in 9 of 15 home-window comparisons. Across the 15 settings, mean accuracy was similar for the room-aware and global Transformers and higher than for the LSTM. Mean micro-AUC and macro-AUC were marginally higher for the global Transformer than for the room-aware Transformer. The room-aware model showed its clearest gains in selected contexts, including Homes C and E at 10 minutes and Home A at 60 minutes, but no architecture or temporal window was uniformly optimal. Sleep/Rest was the most consistently recognized activity, whereas low-support activities frequently had low F1 scores despite moderate or high AUC values. zh_abstract: 【背景】从环境传感器中进行无感的日常生活活动（ADL）识别，可能有助于对轻度神经认知障碍（mild NCD）成人的日常功能进行纵向评估。然而，真实世界中的活动识别因家庭布局、传感器配置、日常作息和类别分布各不相同而变得复杂。【目的】本研究评估保留特定位置传感器结构的房间感知 Transformer，相较于全局 Transformer 和堆叠单向长短期记忆（LSTM）网络，是否能改善参与者层面的 ADL 识别。【方法】在对两名成人志愿者进行试点可行性测试之后，我们分析了五户轻度 NCD 成人的家庭，共包含 67 个已标注家庭日中的 92,765 条分钟级观测。运动、温度、照度、湿度和门接触数据与参与者活动日志对齐。原始标签被统一为八个类别。使用 10、30 和 60 分钟窗口，针对每个家庭分别建立模型。完整的日历日被分配到互不重叠的训练集、验证集和按时间顺序划分的测试集，且没有序列跨越日界或划分边界。三种架构使用相同的划分和评估流程。在保留的测试日上，使用准确率、各类别 F1 分数以及微平均和宏平均的一对多受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）评估性能。【结果】房间感知 Transformer 在 15 个家庭-窗口比较中的 9 个中取得最高或并列最高的准确率。其准确率范围为 0.27 至 0.57，微平均 AUC 为 0.57 至 0.82，宏平均 AUC 为 0.54 至 0.78。在 15 种设置中，房间感知 Transformer 与全局 Transformer 的平均准确率相近，且高于 LSTM。全局 Transformer 的平均微平均 AUC 和宏平均 AUC 略高于房间感知 Transformer。房间感知模型在部分情境中表现出最明显的提升，包括 10 分钟窗口下的家庭 C 和 E，以及 60 分钟窗口下的家庭 A，但没有任何架构或时间窗口在所有情况下都是最优。睡眠/休息是最稳定被识别的活动，而样本支持度低的活动尽管 AUC 值为中等或较高，其 F1 分数却常常较低。【结论】特定房间的特征处理在参与者层面的 ADL 分类中带来了依赖情境的提升，尤其体现在若干家庭-窗口设置下的准确率上。显著的（原文至此中断）

title: HV-MultiScaleGNN: A Multi-Scale Graph Neural Network Framework for Host-Virus Protein-Protein Interactions Prediction
zh_title: HV-MultiScaleGNN：多尺度图神经网络预测宿主-病毒蛋白互作
summary: 提出仅依赖异质互作网络拓扑的多尺度GNN框架，将宿主-病毒蛋白互作预测视为异质链接预测，比较局部、全局及融合视图。
key_points: 整合人类互作组与已验证宿主-病毒互作
探索局部、全局及局部+全局三种视图
不依赖序列或结构信息
reason: 预印本方法，摘要未见充分对比或验证结果
abstract: Accurate identification of HV-PPIs is essential for understanding viral infection mechanisms and for developing antiviral therapeutic discovery. However, the experimental identification process is often time-consuming and expensive, while many computational approaches depend on incomplete protein sequences, structural and interaction information. Here, we present HV-MultiScaleGNN, a topology-driven multi-scale GNN framework for HV-PPIs prediction that operates exclusively on the topology of a heterogeneous interaction network. The framework formulates HV-PPIs prediction as a heterogeneous link prediction problem by integrating the human interactome with experimentally validated HV-PPIs. HV-MultiScaleGNN systematically investigates three complementary graph representation strategies, viz. Local view, Global view and an integrated Local+Global view. The Local view employs one-hop relation-aware graph attention to model fine-grained neighbourhood interactions. The Global view captures higher-order structural dependencies through propagation-based neighbourhood aggregation. The integrated representation combines both views to jointly encode local connectivity and global topological context within a unified embedding space, enabling relation-specific link prediction without relying on sequence- or structure-derived features. Experiments on large-scale HV-PPIs datasets evaluate all three strategies using discrimination, calibration, and ranking metrics. The Local view achieved the best discriminative performance (AUROC = 0.9444, AUPRC = 0.9422), whereas the Global view exhibited the lowest ECE (0.0379). The integrated Local+Global view provided consistently strong predictive performance (AUROC = 0.9378, AUPRC = 0.9356). Comparative evaluation against representative graph representation learning methods showed competitive predictive performance. Furthermore, interfacial interactions were identified using protein-protein docking and atomistic-level understanding was explored. Moreover, GO and KEGG enrichment provided additional functional insights into the selected host proteins. The proposed framework enables systematic evaluation of complementary graph representation strategies for heterogeneous biological link prediction and helps experimental researchers to delineate novel HV-PPIs.
zh_abstract: 准确识别人-病毒蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（HV-PPIs）对于理解病毒感染机制和开发抗病毒治疗药物至关重要。然而，实验识别过程往往耗时且昂贵，而许多计算方法依赖于不完整的蛋白质序列、结构和相互作用信息。在此，我们提出 HV-MultiScaleGNN，一种由拓扑驱动的多尺度 GNN 框架，用于 HV-PPIs 预测，仅基于异质相互作用网络的拓扑结构运行。该框架通过整合人类相互作用组与经实验验证的 HV-PPIs，将 HV-PPIs 预测表述为异质链接预测问题。HV-MultiScaleGNN 系统性地研究了三种互补的图表示策略，即局部视图（Local view）、全局视图（Global view）以及局部+全局整合视图（Local+Global view）。局部视图采用一跳关系感知图注意力来建模细粒度的邻域相互作用。全局视图通过基于传播的邻域聚合来捕捉高阶结构依赖。整合表示将两种视图结合，在统一的嵌入空间中联合编码局部连接性和全局拓扑上下文，从而实现无需依赖序列或结构衍生特征的关系特异性链接预测。在大规模 HV-PPIs 数据集上的实验使用区分度、校准和排序指标对三种策略进行了评估。局部视图取得了最佳的区分性能（AUROC = 0.9444，AUPRC = 0.9422），而全局视图的 ECE 最低（0.0379）。局部+全局整合视图始终提供强劲的预测性能（AUROC = 0.9378，AUPRC = 0.9356）。与代表性图表示学习方法的比较评估显示，其预测性能具有竞争力。此外，通过蛋白质-蛋白质对接识别了界面相互作用，并探讨了原子水平的认识。而且，GO 和 KEGG 富集分析为所选宿主蛋白提供了额外的功能见解。所提出的框架能够对异质生物链接预测的互补图表示策略进行系统评估，并有助于实验研究人员描绘新的 HV-PPIs。

title: Integrating evolutionary and protein language model representations for thermodynamically consistent stability prediction
zh_title: 融合进化信息与蛋白语言模型的热力学一致稳定性预测
summary: 提出免训练策略，将热力学约束与互补序列表示结合，改造EvoPhi-DDG预测器，使稳定性变化预测保证反向一致与路径独立。
key_points: 对MSAesm_ddG预测做反对称化处理
表达为进化信息有效势能之差
保证反转一致性与路径独立性
reason: 预印本，方法有新意但摘要缺少评测结果
abstract: At fixed thermodynamic conditions, protein stability changes obey reversal antisymmetry and path independence, but learned predictors need not satisfy these properties. Explicit alignment-derived evolutionary information may also complement single-sequence protein language model representations, motivating their integration under clearly defined physical constraints. Here, we develop a training-free strategy that combines thermodynamic constraints with complementary sequence representations. We first introduce EvoPhi-DDG, a potential-based adaptation of the alignment-conditioned evolutionary predictor MSAesm_ddG. By antisymmetrizing its predictions and setting the hidden biases to zero, we express stability changes as differences of a learned, evolution-informed effective potential conditioned on the mutation site and alignment context. This guarantees exact reversal consistency and exact same-site transitivity under fixed alignment contexts while preserving predictive accuracy. We further extend the adapted predictor to multiple substitutions through a background-aware construction that preserves whole-variant antisymmetry. We then combine EvoPhi-DDG with the previously published JanusDDG using fixed, equal weight averaging to test predictive complementarity without additional training. The ensemble preserves exact antisymmetry and reduces multisite pathway-closure RMSE relative to JanusDDG across all evaluated path lengths. Furthermore, the ensemble outperforms both components on S669 and S96, achieving Pearson correlations of 0.59 and 0.55, respectively, compared with 0.55 and 0.52 for JanusDDG and 0.53 and 0.48 for EvoPhi-DDG. On the multiple-substitution benchmark PTmul-NR, the ensemble achieves a Pearson correlation of 0.66, improving on JanusDDG's 0.61 and matching the EvoPhi-DDG extension at the reported precision. Together, these findings distinguish two benefits: averaging complementary predictions improves accuracy, whereas the potential-based reformulation strengthens physical consistency. They support the integration of alignment-conditioned and single-sequence representations without additional training, while separating predictive improvements from mathematical guarantees.
zh_abstract: 在固定的热力学条件下，蛋白质稳定性变化遵循反向反对称性和路径无关性，但学习得到的预测器不一定满足这些性质。基于比对的显式进化信息也可能与单序列蛋白质语言模型表征互补，这促使我们在明确定义的物理约束下将二者整合。在此，我们开发了一种无需训练的策略，将热力学约束与互补的序列表征相结合。我们首先提出 EvoPhi-DDG，它是对基于比对条件的进化预测器 MSAesm_ddG 的一种基于势能的改造。通过对其预测进行反对称化并将隐藏偏置设为零，我们将稳定性变化表示为一个以突变位点和比对上下文为条件、经学习得到且融入进化信息的有效势能之差。这在固定比对上下文下保证了精确的反向一致性和精确的同位点传递性，同时保持预测准确性。我们还通过一种考虑背景的构造，将改造后的预测器扩展到多位点替换，从而保持整体变体的反对称性。随后，我们采用固定的等权平均，将 EvoPhi-DDG 与此前发表的 JanusDDG 结合，以在无需额外训练的情况下检验预测的互补性。该集成模型保持精确的反对称性，并在所有评估的路径长度上，相对于 JanusDDG 降低了多位点路径闭合的 RMSE。此外，该集成模型在 S669 和 S96 上优于两个组成模型，Pearson 相关系数分别为 0.59 和 0.55，而 JanusDDG 分别为 0.55 和 0.52，EvoPhi-DDG 分别为 0.53 和 0.48。在多重替换基准 PTmul-NR 上，该集成模型的 Pearson 相关系数为 0.66，优于 JanusDDG 的 0.61，并在所报告的精度下与 EvoPhi-DDG 扩展版本相当。总体而言，这些发现区分了两种益处：对互补预测取平均可提高准确性，而基于势能的重构则增强物理一致性。它们支持在无需额外训练的情况下整合基于比对条件的表征与单序列表征，同时将预测性能的提升与数学保证区分开来。

title: Natural-language cohort queries on a hospital data platform: accuracy and provenance in a real-world evaluation
zh_title: 医院数据平台自然语言队列查询的准确性与溯源评估
summary: 在大学医院对商用自然语言数据查询平台AIRE做概念验证，用25条提示在脑肿瘤队列（n=1,594）上对照人工SQL评估准确性与可追溯性（预印本）。
key_points: 连接三家三级医院的本地部署数据整合平台
25条提示对照人工编写的参考SQL
同时评估查询层面的可追溯性
reason: 单机构概念验证、提示数量少，属增量档
abstract: Background: Accessing routinely collected clinical data for research remains technically demanding across heterogeneous hospital systems. This proof-of-concept study aimed to evaluate the accuracy and query-level traceability of a commercial natural-language (NL) data-query platform implemented at a university hospital. Methods: An on-premises data integration platform with an NL query interface (AIRE; Briya, Tel Aviv, Israel) was connected to the institutional health data platform across three tertiary-care hospitals under an approved pseudonymization and governance framework. Implementation comprised regulatory and governance approval, and IT deployment. Twenty-five NL prompts addressing cohort identification and characterization in an adult ICD-10 C71-coded brain-tumor cohort (n = 1,594) were evaluated against manually written reference SQL and checked for a corresponding executed query in the exported log. Responses were classified into five categories. Prompts with unanswered or incorrect responses were re-posed in a new thread. Results: The platform was implemented over two years. Fifteen of 25 responses were exact (n = 11), concordant after definition alignment (n = 1), or incorrect but traceable from the logged SQL (n = 3); six were plausible but incorrect without a logged query, and four remained unanswered. No incorrect unlogged result recurred in a new thread. Across the initial and repeat evaluations, 22 of 23 logged responses were correct or traceable, whereas all eight unlogged responses were incorrect. Conclusions: Implementation was feasible but required substantial local institutional preparation. The NL interface reproduced SQL-derived results when definitions were explicit, while query-level provenance and verification of the displayed result were critical for identifying unreliable outputs.
zh_abstract: 【背景】在异质性的医院系统中，获取常规收集的临床数据用于研究在技术上仍具挑战。本概念验证研究旨在评估在一所大学医院实施的商用自然语言（NL）数据查询平台的准确性和查询层面的可追溯性。【方法】在经批准的假名化和治理框架下，将带有 NL 查询界面的本地部署数据整合平台（AIRE；Briya，以色列特拉维夫）连接到三所三级医院的机构健康数据平台。实施包括监管与治理审批以及 IT 部署。针对成人 ICD-10 C71 编码脑肿瘤队列（n = 1,594）的队列识别和特征描述，评估了 25 条 NL 提示，并与人工编写的参考 SQL 进行比较，同时检查导出日志中是否有相应的已执行查询。响应被分为五类。对于未回答或回答错误的提示，在新的对话线程中重新提出。【结果】该平台的实施历时两年。25 条响应中有 15 条为精确结果（n = 11）、定义对齐后一致（n = 1）或虽错误但可由日志中的 SQL 追溯（n = 3）；6 条看似合理但错误且无日志查询，4 条仍未得到回答。在新线程中，没有出现未记录日志的错误结果再次出现。在初次和重复评估中，22 条有日志的响应中，有 22 条（共 23 条有日志响应中的 22 条）正确或可追溯，而全部 8 条无日志的响应均为错误。【结论】实施是可行的，但需要大量本地机构层面的准备工作。当定义明确时，NL 界面能够重现由 SQL 得出的结果，而查询层面的溯源以及对所显示结果的核实，对于识别不可靠输出至关重要。

title: Deep-learning-driven tumor microenvironment profiling improves immunotherapy response prediction.
source: PubMed · bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
zh_title: 深度学习肿瘤微环境分析改进免疫治疗反应预测
summary: 提出EcoNet框架，先建模共现细胞状态生态系统，再构建细胞间与细胞内信号网络，并用图注意力网络生成嵌入，用于透明细胞肾癌免疫治疗反应预测。
key_points: 以细胞状态生态系统为基础建模
构建有向信号网络并用图注意力网络
面向ccRCC免疫治疗反应预测
reason: 治疗反应预测新方法预印本，摘要未见外部验证
abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] Immunotherapy has transformed the management of many cancers, such as clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC), yet durable clinical benefit is achieved in only a subset of patients. Immunotherapy outcomes are governed by the multicellular tumor microenvironment (TME), through the structured and directional interplay of regulatory programs and ligand-receptor communications. Yet most existing methods for immunotherapy response prediction rely on independent signatures or cell types and fail to model the structured and directional signaling network within the TME. To address this gap, we introduce EcoNet, a computational framework that first models ecosystems consisting of co-occurring cell states, then constructs intercellular and intracellular signaling networks based on the ecosystems, and applies a graph attention network to derive embeddings from the signaling network for immunotherapy response prediction. Pretrained on 2,532 pan-cancer immunotherapy samples across multiple cohorts, EcoNet outperformed existing prediction methods by 7.5-19.9% and marker-based signatures by 4.4-21.2% in AUC, and its high-attention genes were enriched among those required for T-cell-mediated tumor killing in an independent CRISPR screen; applied to ccRCC with disease-specific fine-tuning, it stratified an independent ccRCC cohort by clinical outcome ( P =0.024). Biologically, high-attention genes capture an interferon-responsive program that enhances antigen presentation and immune infiltration. To validate these findings, we curated a ccRCC clinical cohort profiled with CosMx single-cell spatial transcriptomics (46 samples, ~450,000 cells) and found the response-associated TME configuration identified by EcoNet localized to immune-enriched niches, supporting the response stratification. These results establish EcoNet as a generalizable framework for TME-informed therapeutic response prediction, readily extensible to other cancer types and therapeutic contexts.
zh_abstract: [bioRxiv：生物学预印本服务器] 免疫治疗已改变包括透明细胞肾细胞癌（ccRCC）在内的多种癌症的治疗，但只有一部分患者能获得持久的临床获益。免疫治疗结局由多细胞肿瘤微环境（TME）决定，其通过调控程序与配体-受体通讯之间有结构、有方向的相互作用实现。然而，大多数现有的免疫治疗反应预测方法依赖独立的特征标志或细胞类型，未能对TME内有结构、有方向的信号网络建模。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了EcoNet，这是一个计算框架：首先对由共现细胞状态组成的生态系统建模，然后基于这些生态系统构建细胞间和细胞内信号网络，并应用图注意力网络从信号网络中提取嵌入，用于免疫治疗反应预测。EcoNet在多个队列的2,532份泛癌免疫治疗样本上进行预训练，其AUC较现有预测方法高7.5-19.9%，较基于标志物的特征高4.4-21.2%；其高注意力基因在一项独立的CRISPR筛选中，在T细胞介导的肿瘤杀伤所需基因中富集；应用于ccRCC并进行疾病特异性微调后，它能够按临床结局对一个独立的ccRCC队列进行分层（P =0.024）。在生物学上，高注意力基因反映了一种干扰素应答程序，可增强抗原呈递和免疫浸润。为验证这些发现，我们整理了一个采用CosMx单细胞空间转录组学分析的ccRCC临床队列（46份样本，约450,000个细胞），发现EcoNet所识别的与反应相关的TME构型定位于免疫富集的生态位，支持了该反应分层。这些结果表明，EcoNet是一个可推广的、基于TME信息的治疗反应预测框架，可方便地扩展到其他癌症类型和治疗情境。

title: Embodied Science Agents: Making Embodied Experimental Design Learnable
zh_title: 具身科学智能体：让具身实验设计可学习
summary: 论文主张自驱动实验室应将模型与物理实验结合，沿认知、实验等维度实现可学习性，推动智能体式科学发现。
key_points: 指出现有自驱动实验室中模型与物理接地脱节
提出认知、实验等三个可学习轴
面向智能体式科学发现的立场性框架
reason: AI for science观点类，医疗关联弱，无实证
abstract: Recent advances in large models have accelerated AI for Science toward agentic science, where AI agents autonomously conduct scientific discovery. Realising this vision requires closing the loop between computational reasoning and physical experimentation, positioning self-driving laboratories (SDLs) as critical enablers. However, existing SDLs exhibit a fundamental paradox: foundation model integration has increased linguistic sophistication while severing physical grounding. By treating models as disembodied planners that output symbolic workflows for separate robotic systems, current architectures inherently block the development of embodied experimental intuition. We argue that overcoming this paradox requires embedding \emph{learnability} along three interdependent axes: cognitive learnability (learning what to investigate), experimental learnability (learning where to search), and embodied learnability (learning how to act). Building on this view, we introduce the Embodied Science Agent (ESA), which unifies digital intelligence with physical embodiment through three synergistic components: a Digital Agent that provides cognitive and experimental learnability via memory-based reasoning and Bayesian optimisation, an Embodied Agent that provides embodied learnability via generalisable instrument control, and an Embodied Unified Interface for seamless coordination. We validated ESA in autonomous wastewater treatment experiments, navigating over 200 million possible conditions. Through 15 continuous rounds, ESA raised the final solution transmittance from 82\% to 99.7\%, corresponding to a 98.5\% reduction in residual dye concentration and near-complete decolourisation, while its learned visuomotor policies generalised across varying instrument placements, a promising step toward next-generation SDLs for autonomous scientific discovery.
zh_abstract: 大模型的最新进展加速了 AI for Science 向代理式科学（agentic science）发展，即由 AI 智能体自主开展科学发现。实现这一愿景需要打通计算推理与物理实验之间的闭环，这使自驱动实验室（SDL）成为关键推动者。然而，现有 SDL 存在一个根本性悖论：基础模型的整合提高了语言层面的复杂程度，却切断了与物理世界的联系。由于将模型视为脱离实体的规划者，只为独立的机器人系统输出符号化工作流，当前的架构本质上阻碍了具身实验直觉的形成。我们认为，克服这一悖论需要沿三个相互依赖的维度嵌入“可学习性”：认知可学习性（学习研究什么）、实验可学习性（学习在何处搜索）和具身可学习性（学习如何行动）。基于这一观点，我们提出具身科学智能体（Embodied Science Agent，ESA），它通过三个协同组件将数字智能与物理具身相统一：数字智能体（Digital Agent），通过基于记忆的推理和贝叶斯优化提供认知与实验可学习性；具身智能体（Embodied Agent），通过可泛化的仪器控制提供具身可学习性；以及用于无缝协调的具身统一接口（Embodied Unified Interface）。我们在自主废水处理实验中验证了 ESA，在超过 2 亿种可能条件中进行探索。经过连续 15 轮，ESA 将最终溶液透光率从 82% 提高到 99.7%，对应残留染料浓度降低 98.5% 并几乎完全脱色，同时其习得的视觉运动策略可在不同仪器摆放位置间泛化，这是迈向用于自主科学发现的下一代 SDL 的一个有前景的步骤。

title: Leveraging Deep Learning to Reveal Fine-Scale In Vivo Mitochondrial Dynamics and Axonal Transport.
source: PubMed · The Yale journal of biology and medicine
zh_title: 深度学习揭示体内线粒体动态与轴突运输
summary: 提出深度学习辅助的半自动框架，用于果蝇体内轴突线粒体运输的定量分析，并与专家测量对照验证。
key_points: 基于果蝇活体轴突延时共聚焦成像
量化位移、速度等运输参数
与专家人工测量对比验证保真度
reason: 基础研究工具，模型动物单一场景，增量档
abstract: [The Yale journal of biology and medicine] In axons, mitochondrial transport is essential for neuronal function and survival, and its disruption is increasingly recognized as an early pathological hallmark in multiple neurodegenerative diseases. Despite its importance, quantitative analysis of mitochondrial transport dynamics remains challenging due to complex and heterogeneous motility patterns and reliance on labor-intensive manual tracking methods. Here, we present a deep learning-assisted framework for semiautomated quantification of mitochondrial axonal transport. Using time-lapse confocal imaging of individual in vivo axons in the well-established Drosophila nervous system, we comprehensively validated transport parameters, including displacement and velocity. We further assessed the fidelity of our method in recapitulating expert-derived measurements and its potential to overcome the limitations of conventional manual tracking. Notably, our framework enables detailed characterization of dynamic behaviors during transport, including intensity-based variations and concurrent morphological changes within individual mitochondria, potentially reflecting mitochondrial physiological states that were difficult to resolve with traditional approaches. Collectively, our study establishes the feasibility of next-generation analysis for axonal transport and highlights its potential to uncover previously inaccessible aspects of mitochondrial dynamics, providing a scalable and objective framework for investigating mitochondrial in vivo transport dysfunction in neurodegenerative disease models.
zh_abstract: [The Yale journal of biology and medicine] 在轴突中，线粒体运输对神经元的功能和存活至关重要，其破坏日益被认为是多种神经退行性疾病的早期病理标志。尽管如此，由于运动模式复杂且异质，并且依赖费时费力的人工追踪方法，对线粒体运输动力学进行定量分析仍具有挑战性。在此，我们提出一种深度学习辅助的框架，用于线粒体轴突运输的半自动定量。我们利用成熟的果蝇（Drosophila）神经系统中单个活体轴突的延时共聚焦成像，对包括位移和速度在内的运输参数进行了全面验证。我们进一步评估了该方法再现专家测量结果的保真度，以及其克服传统人工追踪局限性的潜力。值得注意的是，我们的框架能够详细刻画运输过程中的动态行为，包括单个线粒体内基于强度的变化和同时发生的形态变化，这些可能反映了传统方法难以解析的线粒体生理状态。总之，我们的研究确立了新一代轴突运输分析的可行性，并凸显了其揭示线粒体动力学中此前无法触及方面的潜力，为研究神经退行性疾病模型中线粒体体内运输功能障碍提供了可扩展且客观的框架。

title: Domain-Adversarial Adaptation from MURA to In-House Radiographs for Improved Adult Elbow Fracture Classification
zh_title: 从MURA到院内X线片的域对抗成人肘部骨折分类
summary: 用域对抗神经网络把公开MURA数据迁移到小型院内数据集，肘部骨折分类AUC优于仅源域和简单合并基线。
key_points: DANN对齐源域MURA与目标域UofL特征
比较源域、目标域、合并、DANN四种设置
DANN优于源域与合并基线且未过拟合

abstract: We studied domain shift in adult elbow fracture classification from radiographs when training on a large public dataset and deploying on a small, institution-specific dataset (UofL). We implemented a domain-adversarial neural network (DANN) to align feature distributions across source (MURA) and target (UofL) domains while optimizing fracture classification. A pretrained convolutional backbone was adapted to grayscale inputs; the task head predicts fracture presence, and a gradient-reversal-based domain head encourages domain-invariant features via adversarial learning. abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] To investigate the current status of artificial intelligence (AI) readiness among nursing students and analyze its influencing factors, providing evidence for the cultivation of AI literacy in nursing education. A total of 684 nursing students from two universities in Hubei Province were recruited as study participants. Data were collected using a general demographic questionnaire and the Chinese version of the Medical Artificial Intelligence Readiness Scale for Medical Students (C-MAIRS-MS). Descriptive statistics, univariate analysis, and multiple linear regression analysis were employed for data processing. The overall mean score of AI readiness among nursing students was 3.47 ± 0.31; the cognitive dimension scored the highest (3.57 ± 0.44), while the competency dimension scored the lowest (3.32 ± 0.48). abstract: In clinical datasets, data augmentation is often avoided because it can remove important unusual values, known as outliers, which are important for understanding diseases accurately. However, clinical EEG datasets often suffer from two key limitations: small sample sizes and class imbalance, which significantly reduce classification performance. To overcome these challenges, this study applies generative AI-based data augmentation techniques with a carefully designed hybrid pipeline that effectively enhances performance even on limited EEG data. Using EEG signals from 50 brain stroke patients, we investigate both traditional oversampling methods (SMOTE and ADASYN) and advanced generative models, including WGAN and WGAN-GP. Our proposed pipeline involves preprocessing EEG recordings, extracting comprehensive statistical and frequency-domain features, applying feature reduction, and evaluating multiple machine learning classifiers. Experimental results show that the combination of SelectKBest feature selection, SVM classifier, and WGAN-GP augmentation achieves the highest classification accuracy of 72%, outperforming other methods. This work introduces a novel hybrid approach for EEG-based stroke severity classification, demonstrating that generative augmentation, when integrated properly, can significantly improve performance on small clinical datasets. To the best of our knowledge, this combination of techniques has not been explored before on any dataset, providing a solid foundation for future research in automated EEG-based stroke diagnosis.
